Match the existing fine hand-drawn pencil lines, soft textured watercolor / gouache, warm cream wicker furniture, lush bright greenhouse, sunny windows with a blue lake and mountains beyond. Physical sketchbooks may contain faint hand sketches and irregular pencil marks. Exactly two arms / two hands per visible person, correct shoulder-elbow-wrist continuity and believable object contact; no detached or duplicate limbs. Do not merely crop the reference.

Keep their original left/right seated relationship. Preserve the exact cute character model and complete eyes, even with a downward gaze. The open book, forward-leaning pose, downward attention and new camera composition must be clearly different from the closed-book wide reference, while retaining this same room and characters. Single full scenic illustration, no text overlays.
